# llama-cpp

Local LLM inference via `llama-cli` (and `llama-server`, `llama-bench`) with Vulkan offload on the ThinkPad T14's Intel UHD 620 (`ggml-vulkan` + `vulkan-intel`).

Defaults in `~/.config/llama.cpp/config.ini` are tuned for this machine's 4 physical cores (i5-10310U), 16 GiB RAM, and Vulkan iGPU (`threads = 4`, `ctx-size = 8192`, `n-gpu-layers = auto`, `flash-attn = on`, `load-mode = auto`); downloaded GGUF models cache under `~/.cache/llama.cpp`. Explicit CLI flags override these defaults.
